newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, NEW ZEALAND BAT IN INDEPENDENCE CUP.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PAKISTAN WIN TOSS, NEW ZEALAND BAT IN INDEPENDENCE CUP.

text.p: Pakistani captain Rameez Raja won the toss and put New Zealand in to bat in the opening match of the four-nation Independence Cup cricket tournament on Friday.
Pakistan - Rameez Raja (captain), Saeed Anwar, Ijaz Ahmed, Salim Malik, Inzamam-ul-Haq, Shahid Afridi, Moin Khan, Saqlain Mushtaq, Aaqib Javed, Abdul Razzak, Mohammed Hussain.
New Zealand - Stephen Fleming (captain), Nathan Astle, Bryan Young, Matthew Horne, Chris Cairns, Adam Parore, Gavin Larsen, Chris Harris, Dipak Patel, Andrew Penn, Heath Davis.
